PSC::auth_user_name
Description
The PSC::auth_user_name command gets the authentication user name or
sets the authentication user name when the optional value is given.
Syntax
PSC
::
auth_user_name
PSC
::
auth_user_name
<
name
>
PSC::auth_user_name
retrieve the authentication user name
PSC::auth_user_name <name>
set the authentication user name
